en: A vintage blue‑toned postcard announcing a festival or celebration. It shows an illustrated cavalry soldier on horseback holding a flag and a rifle, with a stylized background landscape and large curved title text above him. The date 22., 23. ja 24. juunil 1924 is printed prominently at the top, and additional text in Estonian appears at the bottom, commemorating heroes of the War of Independence on the eastern front.
